content: The other previous work for Japanese INLINEFORM0 Vietnamese uses SMT BIBREF19 . They also conducted the experiments on parallel corpora collected from TED talks. They used phrase-based and tree-to-string models and have shown that the SMT system trained on French INLINEFORM1 Vietnamese obtains better results than the system of Japanese INLINEFORM2 Vietnamese because French and Vietnamese have more similarities in the structures of sentences than between Japanese and Vietnamese. We also built phrase-based systems on the TED data and achieved better BLEU scores when using NMT.
